meta.title: EZMusicProduction — open-source DAW for macOS
meta.description: EZMusicProduction — an open-source digital audio workstation (DAW) for macOS. Sound library, EZInstruments, EZSynth, EZDrums, EZOrquestra, Piano Roll and Cubase project import.
meta.ogDescription: Complete music production in a single window. Sound library, EZ instruments, a full Piano Roll and direct import of Cubase projects.

site.tagline: Complete music production, in a single window.

hero.title: Your music production studio, <hl>built in the open</hl>.
hero.subtitle: EZMusicProduction is an open-source DAW for macOS. {{tagline}} Its own instruments, a sound library with project-tempo-matched preview and a full Piano Roll, all included.

items.title: Classic timeline, fast flow
items.text: A linear multitrack timeline, per-channel mixer with inserts and sends, parameter automation… and, at the same time, drag & drop as the very first action and a library with preview synced to the project.

items.title: Its own instruments, not a plugin catalogue
items.text: EZInstruments, EZSynth, EZDrums and EZOrquestra live inside the app: no third-party windows, no extra licences, and a project that is ready to play from the first minute.

items.title: Native on macOS and open source
items.text: Flutter UI, a C++20/23 audio engine with JUCE and an FFI bridge built on snapshots. No disk I/O on the audio thread and no black boxes: the code is yours.

whatIs.title: A complete linear DAW, without the strings
whatIs.intro: Record, edit, mix and automate with studio-grade depth, but with the immediacy of opening the app and starting to play. Everything happens in a single window: multitrack timeline, lower zone with editor and mixer, and instruments that already ship with it.

features.title: What makes EZMusicProduction special
features.intro: Every piece is designed around a real production flow: find the sound, play it, edit the notes and carry the project to the end without leaving the app.

instruments.title: Four instruments of its own, inside the app
instruments.intro: No external libraries or separate installers: EZInstruments, EZSynth, EZDrums and EZOrquestra open right from the track and store their state inside the project.

pianoRoll.title: A Piano Roll with studio-grade depth
pianoRoll.intro: Non-destructive quantization with iQ is the difference: try grids, swing and catch range without fear, because the original positions stay there until you decide to commit them.

cubase.title: Open your Cubase projects
cubase.intro: Import your Cubase projects and don't start from scratch: your tracks, MIDI notes and audio events come along with the project, and you can keep working here in the app's own save format.

architecture.title: An architecture built to stay out of the audio's way
architecture.intro: The interface shows live data without ever getting close to the audio thread. Between the UI and the engine there are only commands, snapshots and streams.

download.title: Start producing today
download.text: Download the app for macOS or build it from source. The project is under active development and every new feature lands in the repository.

libreria.title: Sound Library
libreria.description: A browser with over 21,000 free sounds —loops, one-shot samples, orchestral, percussion, synth, vocals and Foley— indexed and ready to drag onto the timeline. The preview is the signature touch: the loop plays stretched to the project tempo and transposed to its key, and starts right on the playhead's beat.
bullets: 21,000+ sounds with visible licence and authorship (CC, public domain…)
Tempo-matched preview, transposed to the project key
Drums and percussion with one-shot samples, ready to build your own patterns
Drag & drop straight onto the timeline: creates a track or inserts a clip where you drop
Filters by category, tempo, key, instrument and genre

ezinstruments.title: EZInstruments
ezinstruments.description: The General MIDI instrument collection built into the app: 128 melodic programs plus the percussion kit in a single processor, with instant sound for sketching any idea. Reverb and chorus are deliberately switched off: space and character come from the track's FX chain, not the instrument.
bullets: Complete GM catalogue: 128 melodic programs + percussion kit
Embedded FluidSynth engine (LGPL 2.1+) with our own glue
No internal reverb/chorus: the colour belongs to the track's FX chain
Great for sketching: pick it, play it and keep producing

ezsynth.title: EZSynth
ezsynth.description: A modern subtractive synth with the piano roll of its own clip built in. The engine offers three oscillators with unison, a sub oscillator and a noise generator, a multimode ladder filter with its own envelope, two LFOs, glide and velocity response. A preset bank covers the fast path; LINES is the deep one.
bullets: Three oscillators + unison + sub + noise
Multimode ladder filter with a dedicated envelope
Two LFOs, glide and velocity sensitivity
A preset bank to get going without friction
LINES: pitch-distortion areas drawn over the roll with a genuinely polyphonic effect (each note of a chord bends on its own)

ezdrums.title: EZDrums
ezdrums.description: A drum machine with synthesized 808/909-style kits —zero assets, zero downloads— and a bank of patterns across styles. Everything plays locked to the project tempo and time signature in a loop, and best of all: with the track armed, the pattern is recorded as real MIDI into a clip, as if a drummer had performed it. Then you edit it in the usual piano roll.
bullets: Synthesized 808/909 kits, no external samples
A bank of ready-to-use patterns by style
Loop locked to the project tempo and time signature
Generates MIDI: records the pattern into a real, editable clip

ezorquestra.title: EZOrquestra
ezorquestra.description: Our own orchestral sampler implementation. It plays freely-licensed sample libraries following the Alpine Project layout: per-note WAV files with the note, articulation and dynamics encoded in the filename. JSON programs with a per-sample root note, velocity layers and round-robin groups deliver the realism you expect from a string section.
bullets: Strings, brass and woodwinds with articulations and dynamics
Format compatible with the Alpine Project (per-note WAV files)
JSON programs with root note, velocity layers and round-robin
Pitch detector with label verification for preparing libraries

pianoRoll.title: Piano Roll
pianoRoll.description: The note editor: a full canvas to write, move and shape your music in every detail. The key piece here is non-destructive quantization: original positions are never lost until you decide so, which means you can try a different preset and go back without undoing anything. Every gesture is an action and every action is an undo step.
bullets: Non-destructive quantization: factory presets 1/4 … 1/32 with triplets and dotted values
Q / iQ mode: apply fully or step forward with Iterative Strength
Swing (straight grids only), Catch Range, Max Move and Non-Grid Positions
Ghost display of the original position and Freeze Quantize when you want to commit
Velocity and CC lanes (modwheel, volume, expression, sustain)
Smart vertical auto-scroll, key preview on click and numeric editing in the info line

cubase.title: Opening Cubase projects
cubase.description: Open your Cubase projects straight from the file picker: the .cpr reader is written in pure Dart and recreates the project in the engine. It's read-only —we never write back to the original file, saving stays .ezmpp— but it brings along everything you need to pick up where you left off.
bullets: Full project structure: tracks, tempo and time signature
MIDI notes verified 1:1 against SMFs exported by Cubase itself
Audio events with position, trim, gain and source file
Instruments and effects restored with their state
Read-only: your original .cpr is never modified

items.title: Flutter
items.text: The skin, never the heart of the audio. Timeline, mixer, inspector and dialogs; it consumes engine streams and never blocks the audio thread.

items.title: FFI over snapshots
items.text: Commands, snapshots and streams between the UI and the engine. No per-audio-block calls.

items.title: C++20/23 + JUCE
items.text: Project model, mixing, offline render and undo/redo live in the engine. Audio sources are decoded into memory so the disk is never touched during playback.

items.q: Which platforms does it run on?
items.a: macOS 12 or later, on both Apple Silicon and Intel. Windows is planned for a later release.

items.q: Is it free? Is it open source?
items.a: The project is open source. The engine uses JUCE and FluidSynth (LGPL 2.1+) linked dynamically, and the final licence for the whole is being evaluated between AGPLv3 and a commercial licence.
Yes. The initial release hosts AU and VST3 on macOS; CLAP is planned for later. On top of that, the EZ instruments are included out of the box.

items.q: Can I save back into Cubase?
items.a: No. .cpr import is read-only by design: we open your projects, we never modify them. The app's own save format is .ezmpp.

items.q: Can I contribute sounds to the library?
items.a: Yes. The library is indexed from local folders and shows the licence and authorship of every sound, so it's easy to bring in free material.

footer.description: Complete music production in a single window. An open-source DAW for macOS, with its own instruments and a sound library included.
